leaves.title: Map the Door Home
leaves.contentsListing: Map the Door Home · a way through the wrong castle
leaves.instruction: The wrong castle left a few doors behind. Draw a way from the Count to his open book. Pass the source, the invitation, and the place where Serenity let the black thread go. Watch the red chair.
leaves.accessibilityDescription: A square maze with Count at the upper left and Book at the lower right; visit Source, Invitation, and Claim Released in order. The red chair is a dead end.

leaves.title: A Threshold of My Own
leaves.contentsListing: A Threshold of My Own · a door with two sides
leaves.instruction: Draw a door. Give it a handle if you think it deserves one.
leaves.body: Leave a little room at the hinge. Doors change their minds there. The page keeps what you write.

leaves.accessibilityDescription: Two large writing and drawing spaces for the inviting and protective sides of a personal door.
